notes: Variant WLC.2SA.24.16.v002 resolved to r00-base; s038 and s039 aligned on that projection (rule 9).
The margin Or, Ornah was read and set aside (rule 38).
The It of It is enough is added and is enough goes to רַב: the ASV writes enough alone for that predicate elsewhere, which is the case rule 20 names in its own terms.
The article on הָאֲרַוְנָה takes the phrase's single the, which English fronts because the rectum is rendered anarthrously (rule 29).
